title: GetSigmaJobResponse
description: Detailed result of a Sigma rule generation job including status, generated rules, and patterns.

sigma_rules.title: Sigma Rules
sigma_rules.description: The Sigma Rules and associated stats.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.description: The generated patterns and associated stats

EndDate.description: Latest date to include in the query, defaults to today in UTC

FamilyCounts.title: Family Counts
FamilyCounts.description: Statistics over number of matched hashes per malware family

image.title: Parent Image
image.description: Parent image, optionally with wildcard replacement

cmd_pattern.title: Command line pattern
cmd_pattern.description: Command line, optionally with wildcard replacement

matched_cmds.title: Matched Commands
matched_cmds.description: List of command lines matching this pattern

jobId.title: Job ID
jobId.description: A unique identifier for the Sigma job.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the Sigma job.

created.title: Created
created.description: The timestamp when the Sigma job was created.

modified.title: Modified
modified.description: The timestamp when the Sigma job was last updated.

status.title: Status
status.description: The current status of the Sigma job (e.g., "CREATED", "RUNNING", "FINISHED", "FAILED").

query.title: Query
query.description: The query that was used to find the initial hashes.

nMatchedHashes.title: Number of matched hashes
nMatchedHashes.description: Number of hashes matching the query during specified time range

SigmaJobBase.title: SigmaJobBase
SigmaJobBase.description: Base properties shared across Sigma job responses.

n_hashes.title: Number of hashes
n_hashes.description: Number of hashes matching the pattern

overlap.title: Overlap
overlap.description: Number of hashes matching both pattern and job query

SigmaPatternStats.description: Statistics about patterns identified during Sigma rule generation.

modified.title: Modified
modified.description: The timestamp when the rule was last updated. Not present if rule was never updated.

StartDate.description: Earliest date to include in the query (cannot be before 2023-11-01)
